summary: Fixed a real P1 security finding from Greptile's review of the publish PR (mvanhorn/printing-press-library#1767): internal/client/client.go's New() seeded the real Concur session cookie (JWT/_csrf) into the HTTP client's cookie jar scoped to whatever cfg.BaseURL currently was, with no check that BaseURL actually pointed at concursolutions.com. A --base-url or CONCUR_BASE_URL override pointed at an unrelated host (or a plain-HTTP one) would carry the real session credential to that endpoint on every relative request -- a genuine credential-leak vector, not a false positive.
reason: Greptile's review verified the unrestricted base URL flows directly into SeedCookieJar and is also used to construct relative request URLs. Fix: added baseURLIsTrustedConcurHost(rawURL) (checks the URL's host is concursolutions.com or a subdomain of it) and gated the SeedCookieJar call on it; when the base URL is untrusted and a credential exists, warn on stderr and skip seeding rather than silently leaking the cookie. The already-persisted cookie jar (LoadCookieJar) is unaffected -- those cookies carry their own correct domain fields from capture time and are not sent cross-domain by net/http's own cookie matching regardless; this fix is specifically about the additional credential the client layer seeds on top of that.

changes.description: Added concurCookieDomain constant and baseURLIsTrustedConcurHost(rawURL) helper. New()'s SeedCookieJar call is now gated on that check; an untrusted base URL with a stored credential prints a warning to stderr and skips seeding instead of leaking the cookie to that host.

validated_outcome: go build, go vet ./..., and go test ./... all clean. Functional check: 'doctor' against the real base URL (www-us2.api.concursolutions.com) seeds the cookie with no warning, unchanged from before. 'CONCUR_BASE_URL=http://example.com doctor' now prints 'warning: base URL "http://example.com" is not a concursolutions.com host -- not sending your Concur session cookie to it' and does not attach the real session cookie to that request.
